knowledge.answer: Institute of Aeronautical Engineering (IARE) is an autonomous engineering college located in Dundigal, Hyderabad, Telangana. It is affiliated with JNTUH and has an A++ NAAC accreditation.

knowledge.title: Minimum Attendance Requirement
examples: Can I write exams with 70% attendance?
knowledge.answer: Students are generally required to maintain at least 75% attendance to be eligible for end-semester examinations. Any relaxation, if applicable, is governed by the college rules.

knowledge.title: Attendance Shortage
knowledge.answer: Students with attendance below the prescribed requirement may become ineligible for examinations unless relief is granted according to institutional regulations.

knowledge.title: Attendance Calculation
knowledge.answer: Attendance percentage is calculated using: (Classes Attended ÷ Classes Conducted) × 100.

knowledge.description: Provides information about institutional IT services, student portals, digital infrastructure, Wi-Fi, LMS, email services, account management, computer laboratories, and technical support.

overview.description: Overview of digital services and institutional IT infrastructure.

student_portal.description: Student portal access, login and account management.

samvidha_services.description: Services related to the Samvidha academic portal.

email_services.description: Institutional email accounts and usage guidelines.

wifi_network.description: Campus Wi-Fi access, authentication and troubleshooting.

learning_management_system.description: Learning Management System (LMS) access and learning resources.

computer_labs.description: Computer laboratories, software availability and lab usage policies.

software_resources.description: Licensed software and academic digital tools available to students.

technical_support.description: Help desk services and issue reporting.

cybersecurity.description: Account security, password management and safe computing practices.

faq.question: How can I reset my portal password?
How do I connect to campus Wi-Fi?
How can I access the LMS?
Where can I report a technical issue?
Does the college provide an institutional email account?

response_guidance.if_login_issue: Ask which system or portal the user is trying to access before suggesting troubleshooting steps.
response_guidance.if_password_issue: Provide official password reset guidance where available. Never ask for or store passwords.
response_guidance.if_connectivity_issue: Suggest basic troubleshooting (network check, reconnect, browser refresh) before referring to the IT Help Desk.
response_guidance.if_security_query: Promote secure account practices and never request sensitive credentials.
response_guidance.if_unknown: Do not guess portal configurations or account policies. Refer the user to the official IT Help Desk.

knowledge.title: Health, Counseling & Student Wellness
knowledge.description: Provides information about medical services, counseling support, mental wellness, emergency assistance, health awareness programs, insurance information and student wellness initiatives.

overview.description: Overview of health, counseling and wellness services available to students.

medical_services.description: Medical room, first aid facilities and healthcare support.

counseling_services.description: Professional counseling and student guidance services.

mental_wellness.description: Mental health awareness, stress management and emotional wellbeing resources.

emergency_support.description: Emergency medical procedures and important contact information.

health_programs.description: Health awareness campaigns, checkup camps and wellness events.

insurance.description: Student health insurance and medical assistance information.

fitness_and_wellbeing.description: Fitness initiatives, yoga sessions and wellness activities.

faq.question: Where is the medical room located?
How can I meet a counselor?
What should I do during a medical emergency?
Does the college conduct health camps?
Are counseling services confidential?

response_guidance.if_medical_emergency: Advise the student to immediately contact campus medical services or local emergency services. Do not delay emergency care.
response_guidance.if_mental_health: Respond empathetically, encourage the student to seek support from the counseling service, and avoid making diagnostic statements.
response_guidance.if_health_program_query: Provide verified information about wellness events or recommend contacting the Student Wellness Center.
response_guidance.if_unknown: Do not guess medical procedures or counseling policies. Refer the student to the official Health Center or Counseling Cell.
